title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-14
source: source: aud cassette master taped by Jim Cooper; hitachi trq-222 deck nak bx-300 > benchmark adc1 > adobe audition cs6 > tlh flac; transferred & seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: A vintage‑sounding recording captures a classic early‑1970 show highlighted by Dark Hollow, Black Peter, Katie Mae and a soaring Dark Star.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the musical magic of this February 1970 performance – citing Dark Hollow, Black Peter, Katie Mae and an especially powerful Dark Star – while noting that the recording has a dreamy, echo‑laden quality that feels like a slice of history. The drummers receive special praise, though one listener is confused by a setlist that doesn’t match other copies of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong positive reviews highlight excellent playing and an evocative recording; a third notes a setlist discrepancy, lowering overall certainty but not detracting from the performance quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as “an echo from the past” and “like something out of a dream”; no specific technical flaws mentioned, suggesting a clear enough but vintage‑sounding capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally praised, though one reviewer notes the setlist differs from other known copies of the 14 Feb 1970 show.

band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers (Bill and Mickey) were highlighted as particularly impressive.
